decision_authority.policy: MRX continuous quality-gated publication and two-image article creative directive

title: Unlocking the Mystery: Key Details for an Accurate Mineral Rights Review Process
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 96e5fb89381484fc079f61ec944519064badac05515d540f7bc91418f091cfd2; all 10 declared sources passed live access review.

Claims remain bounded to current RRC royalty-payment, division-order, well-record, query-identity, reporting-lag, and correction context; Texas recording, county-record, estate, and payor-information statutes; and current MRX methodology and selling-options scope. The article preserves each source purpose and does not turn any source into an owner-specific title, authority, legal effect, reserves, future production, value, tax result, offer, or decision result.

The article uses no fabricated owners, properties, buyers, contracts, prices, acreage, ownership decimals, production, reserves, forecasts, tax results, offers, testimonials, success rates, or owner-specific title, legal, tax, accounting, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusions.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas Royalties FAQ (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas Royalties FAQ describes information associated with royalty payments and division orders and identifies paths for requesting certain lease, property, or well identifiers.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for payment-record fields, division-order matching, and identifier follow-up; it does not establish complete title, ownership, reserves, future production, value, or legal effect.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas oil and gas well records (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas well-records page describes public search paths and identifiers such as county, operator, field, API number, drilling-permit number, lease or gas-well identity, survey, abstract, section, and block.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to explain reproducible property and well identity; it does not prove private title, tract inclusion, owner decimal, reserves, future development, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas About Oil & Gas Data Queries (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas query guide explains public oil-and-gas data identities, including API wellbore identity and lease or gas-well completion identifiers.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to keep record identifiers and query paths explicit; it does not resolve private ownership, title, contract effect, production entitlement, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas Production Data Query FAQs (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The RRC Production Data Query FAQs explain operator-reported production, Texas lease-versus-well reporting, reporting lag, and later revisions, corrections, or late filings.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to require retrieval dates, periods, identifiers, and version controls for public operating evidence; it does not establish owner-specific title, payment, reserves, future production, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Property Code Chapter 12 (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas Property Code Chapter 12 provides statutory context for recording instruments concerning property.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the chapter only to explain why complete recorded instruments and recording references may matter; it does not interpret a particular instrument or establish an owner-specific title conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Local Government Code Chapter 191 (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas Local Government Code Chapter 191 identifies the county clerk as county recorder and addresses authorized records and indexing.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the chapter only for county-record context; it does not determine the legal effect, priority, completeness, or ownership result of any record.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Estates Code Chapter 101 (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas Estates Code Chapter 101 provides statutory context for estate vesting subject to administration and liabilities.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the chapter only to explain why estate records and authority may be relevant; it does not decide inheritance, probate, heirship, authority, curative requirements, or title.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Natural Resources Code Chapter 91 (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas Natural Resources Code Chapter 91 provides statutory context for certain payor information and identification requests discussed by the RRC.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the chapter only for record-retrieval and payment-information context; it does not establish complete ownership, lease interpretation, title, production entitlement, or value.

sources_inspected.label: MRX methodology (accessed 2026-08-13)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX methodology describes the evidence, assumptions, scenarios, and professional limits of a directional mineral-rights review.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to bound a scoped directional review and its handoffs; it does not establish owner-specific title, reserves, value, legal effect, tax treatment, suitability, or a transaction result.
